definitionZh: 变换箱 CSS 属性定义了变换,个人变换属性翻译,规模化,旋转,变换原产属性相关的布局框.
sourceDefinition: The transform-box CSS property defines the layout box to which the transform, individual transform properties translate, scale, and rotate, and transform-origin properties relate.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The transform-box CSS property defines the layout box to which the transform, individual transform properties translate, scale, and rotate, and transform-origin properties relate.
